name: Queen's Tower

geometryEvidence.note: Subject footprint in inherited OSM geometry; sight line intersects only this tower.
Photo spot is 4.4 m from the mapped Imperial College Road pedestrian way in cached geometry; not inside a building. A map proximity check does not establish current access.

photoSpotReason: South of the tower, facing north from the Imperial College Road pedestrian area; rechecked against inherited OSM geometry. On-site access and reference-photo framing still require confirmation.

referencePhoto.author: David Richfield
referencePhoto.crop: Padded, not cropped: the 1920x2102 Commons thumbnail minus its bottom 3% (a white stitching wedge) scaled to 847x900 and centred at x=377; each side band is the same photo blurred (sigma 40) and dimmed to 85%. Made with spikes/agent-5/pad-reference.mjs. A 16:9 crop cannot hold the 87 m tower from this distance without losing the dome or the base.
referencePhoto.notes: Wide-angle view of the south face from Queen's Lawn, close to the photo spot and facing north: whole tower from dome to entrance steps, both lions, college buildings left, trees right. One passer-by, small and off-centre. The file GPS (51.498400, -0.176940) is about 5 m from the tower, so it records the subject, not the camera; takenFrom is left null and facingDeg 0 is read from the view. The blurred side bands are padding for the image model to repaint, not evidence. Replace with the team H1 photo when it arrives.

eraYearsReason.1893: Formal opening on 10 May 1893; period images document the connected frontage.
eraYearsReason.1962: Commonwealth Institute moves to Holland Park during demolition and campus replacement; retain existing candidate, with a thin-record dossier.

openQuestions: Replace the Commons stand-in with the team H1 photo (wide-angle, landscape, whole tower) when it arrives.
